description: This Java interface defines service methods for retrieving account and loan account details for clients and groups within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: AccountDetailsReadPlatformService
classes.description: A service interface for retrieving account details and loan account summaries for clients and groups.

methods.name: retrieveClientAccountDetails
methods.description: Retrieves account details associated with a specific client.

methods.name: retrieveGroupAccountDetails
methods.description: Retrieves account details associated with a specific group.

methods.name: retrieveClientLoanAccountsByLoanOfficerId
methods.description: Retrieves loan accounts for a client filtered by loan officer ID.

methods.name: retrieveGroupLoanAccountsByLoanOfficerId
methods.description: Retrieves loan accounts for a group filtered by loan officer ID.

methods.name: retrieveClientActiveLoanAccountSummary
methods.description: Retrieves summaries of active loan accounts for a client.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAccountDetailsByGroupIdAndGlimAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves loan account details for a group by group ID and GLIM account number.

methods.name: retrieveGroupActiveLoanAccountSummary
methods.description: Retrieves summaries of active loan accounts for a group.

methods.name: retrieveGroupAccountDetails
methods.description: Retrieves account details for a group, with an optional gsimId parameter.
